syntheticReplies.text:
That makes a lot of sense — putting things off is really common, and you don't need a reason to justify it. It's okay to just sit with that for now.

If there's anything specific about it that's on your mind — practical, logistical, or otherwise — I'm happy to help when you're ready. No pressure either way.
That's a really useful thing to share with your practice — they may have options that can help. Here's a draft you can edit before doing anything with it.

suggestion.title: Question for your practice about blood draw support
suggestion.text: Hi, I wanted to let you know that I felt faint during my last blood draw. Before I schedule my next one, could you let me know what support options are available to help me feel more comfortable? Thank you.
